localReproduction.mechanism: Apple Python 3.9.6 _communicate only registers stdin for EVENT_WRITE when self.stdin and input. The wrapper sets input=None after its first 100 ms TimeoutExpired, so any incomplete write is never resumed and EOF is not delivered. communicate also rejects nonempty input once _communication_started is true.
